adoptedStructure: Reality Closure retains complete exact source evidence
Human Closure selects a verified claim subset and authors the final answer in the same second model call
exact cell, row, and bounded line regions materialize evidence without repeating every atom ID
manifest-scoped short atom aliases preserve runtime identity while reducing provider wire cost
same-unit numeric difference facts are available independent of the model claim-state label
cross-source identity uses handle plus location rather than location alone
XLSX header-observed units bind following numeric cells and Excel date serials stay out of Human Closure
